title: feat(nsuoy): nsopp y-probe later-tick S_* union own lock: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Later-tick lock set union own lock on nsopp y-probes: the union genuinely enlarges S_*(A) by the seed letter -e1 (which no six-neighbour of A carries by T=3), giving a full six-letter set. The verdict pair is unchanged from the union-free readout, so the enlargement is demonstrably verdict-irrelevant at this rung of the window chain.
